title: grammitis walleri
intro: Grammitis walleri, commonly known as Waller's Grammitis, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Grammitis walleri include wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system support, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Research suggests that these compounds may contribute to the plant's ability to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage.
